TRAVEL BETTER TOGETHER

A little consideration
goes a long way.

Everyone deserves to feel welcome, comfortable and included—whether they joined solo or with friends.

✓ Do
  • Invite others into conversations and group plans; leave room for anyone who prefers quiet time.
  • Respect personal space, pronouns, boundaries and different backgrounds.
  • Be on time for departures, and tell the captain early if you need help.
  • Keep shared rooms and vehicles tidy and keep noise low during rest hours.
  • Ask before photographing, tagging or sharing someone else’s image.
× Don’t
  • Exclude, tease, harass or make discriminatory remarks about fellow travellers.
  • Pressure anyone to drink, join an activity, share personal details or appear in a photo.
  • Play loud music or take calls on speaker in shared spaces without the group’s agreement.
  • Take or use another traveller’s belongings without asking.
  • Ignore someone’s discomfort—let the captain know privately if you need support.

Need a hand or feeling uncomfortable? Speak to the trip captain privately.

ILLUSTRATIVE CANCELLATION POLICY

Plans change. Know where you stand.

Cancel before departure. The charge below is a percentage of the total trip price; the rest is refundable.

30+ days100% refundNo cancellation charge
21–29 days75% refund25% cancellation charge
15–20 days50% refund50% cancellation charge
0–14 daysNo refund100% cancellation charge

How it works: Days are counted as calendar days before the departure date in India; departure day is day 0. The charge is capped at the amount paid; refund = amount paid minus the applicable charge. If YatraLoop cancels the trip, you receive a full refund of the amount paid. Approved refunds return to the original payment method within 7–10 business days.

Unavoidable changes, including weather or road closures, will be communicated as early as possible. If the trip is cancelled by the operator, the full-refund rule above applies. This is an illustrative policy for the fictional YatraLoop concept.
